queries.negative_balance: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE balance_minor<0
queries.balance_conservation: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT u.id FROM users u LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.user_id=u.id AND p.status='SUCCEEDED' GROUP BY u.id,u.balance_minor HAVING u.balance_minor+coalesce(sum(p.amount_minor),0)<>1000000) t
queries.balance_vs_ledger_debit: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT u.id FROM users u LEFT JOIN ledger_entries l ON l.account='USER_BALANCE' AND l.direction='DEBIT' AND l.account_ref=u.id GROUP BY u.id,u.balance_minor HAVING u.balance_minor+coalesce(sum(l.amount_minor),0)<>1000000) t
queries.pending_hold_exceeds_balance: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT u.id FROM users u JOIN payments p ON p.user_id=u.id AND p.status='PENDING' GROUP BY u.id,u.balance_minor HAVING sum(p.amount_minor)>u.balance_minor) t
queries.agency_balance: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT a.id FROM agencies a LEFT JOIN settlements s ON s.agency_id=a.id GROUP BY a.id,a.settlement_balance_minor HAVING a.settlement_balance_minor<>coalesce(sum(s.net_minor),0)) t
queries.ledger_debit_credit_total: SELECT abs(coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN direction='DEBIT' THEN amount_minor ELSE -amount_minor END),0)) FROM ledger_entries
